recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The substantive FHIR-13705 model was already present, and this narrowly removes later source drift caused by the reasonCode/reasonReference to reason merge; no further Communication.topic or CommunicationRequest.topic work is needed for this issue.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows Communication and CommunicationRequest are active current-build resources and maps the old reasonCode/reasonReference elements into the current reason element, with reasonReference specifically mapping to reason.reference. The original Zulip thread supports the same distinction between why a communication happened and what resource it is about; no Confluence or Jira-neighborhood search found a conflicting later decision.
